title: The Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5 does not protect or remove the diagnostic archive it…
description: The Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin versions before 7.5.5 do not secure or delete diagnostic archives created when an administrator exports logs. These archives, stored in the uploads folder and named only by export date, can be accessed by unauthenticated visitors, exposing logs that include visitor IP addresses and system information.
